guildInfo.about: Kaizen is a chill but serious Horde raiding guild pushing into 25-man progression content on TBC Classic. We're building a solid, consistent roster of players who show up prepared, respect each other's time, and want to actually clear content — without the toxicity. If that sounds like you, come hang.
guildInfo.recruitment:
We are actively building our 25-man roster and looking for reliable, raid-ready players.

Current loot system:
2 Soft Reserves · MS > OS + 1

All specs considered — reach out on Discord if you're interested in running with us.
guildInfo.lootRules:
2 Soft Reserves (SR) — each raider may reserve up to 2 items per raid week.
MS > OS — main spec rolls beat off spec rolls on all items.
+1 Rule — once you win a main spec item, you go to the back of the line for subsequent drops that night.

tools.name: That's My BIS
tools.desc: Raiders pre-list their BIS items by priority. When loot drops, loot council can instantly see who has it highest on their list, making decisions fast and transparent. Sign up at thatsmybis.com with your Discord account.

tools.name: Gargul
tools.desc: In-game addon used by the loot master to manage rolls, track MS/OS, and distribute loot cleanly. Integrates directly with TMB. Install via CurseForge — only the loot master strictly needs it, but raiders benefit from having it too.

tools.name: Method Raid Tools
tools.desc: Essential raid leader addon. Tracks raid cooldowns, manages assignments, handles notes and reminders, and inspects raiders gear and specs. Required for officers, strongly recommended for all raiders. Install via CurseForge.

rows.valueA: Hunters kill sporebats, isolate if you have static charge, stay out of poison, paladins blessing of freedom on tanks, shamans grounding totem down!

Coilfang Hate-Screamer - Kill first in all packs, has silence

Underbog Colossus - Acid Geyser: Run to tank
Spore Quake: Run away from mob
Coilfang Priestess - Kill first, has an AOE heal/damage

Greyheart Tidecaller - Kill first, kill totems that spawn water elementals.

Greyheart Nether-Mage - Keep sheeped while killing them. Does AOE damage.

Greyheart Shield-Bearer - STACK on these guys, they will charge. Can be catastrophic if there are multiple.
Coilfang Fathom-Witch - Kill first, will MC. Best to CC your MC'd friends.

Astromancer - Kill first, does AOE blast wave. Purge Molten Armor.

Star Scryer - Keep/spam sheep, can MC and does AOE arcane damage.

Bloodwarder Legionnaire - Tank separate from group. Does Whirlwind.

Bloodwarder Marshal - Patrol pat, comes with squires. Does Whirlwind.

Bloodwarder Vindicator - Uncleansable Flash of Light heal, Hammer of Justice stun, and Cleanse (dispels our CC on nearby mobs) - keep sheeped targets away from Vindicators so Cleanse can't break the polymorph. (Difficulty/pacing notes from the source guide are pre-nerf and may not hold on this server's current tuning - verify live, this line is just the ability kit.)

Crystalcore Sentinel - AOE Arcane damage. Does Overcharge. When this ability happens OT can taunt.

Crystalcore Devastator - Countercharge does reflect damage on auto attacks.

Crystalcore Mechanic - Banish. Saw blade does massive AOE +Bleed damage.

Tempest Smith - Keep/spam sheep. Does AOE bomb damage that reduces armor.
Nether Scryer - Kill first. MASS mind control. Must be tanked out of main room. CC your MC'd friends.

Crimson Hand Battle Mage - Kill first. Has 3 Mass AOE skills.

Crimson Hand Centurion - Keep/spam sheep. Arcane Flurry will kill everyone.

Spread 6 yards with a buddy system to pull Impaling Spines. Lust on pull. Before popping Tidal Shield with a spine, make sure everyone is above ~8,500 HP - he only regens 1% per second, so there's no need to rush it.

60-second phases. Phase 1: OT stays in melee range and topped off so DPS don't soak Hateful Strike; everyone spreads (melee included) right before the Phase 2 transition. Phase 2: stay 5-40 yards, run if targeted (the ramp works for kiting), dodge fire/volcanoes, and hold DPS just before he flips back to Phase 1.

Phase 1: kill the 6 channelers - tanks cover the spawn doorways, feed a spare add into the middle as a Seed of Corruption target. Phase 2: tanks hold adds, healers keep them up, lust and burn Akama - you have 60 seconds before he loses to the boss instead.

Tank and spank, lust on pull. When Shadow of Death triggers, that player becomes a Spirit and solos 4 Shadowy Constructs using the 5-4-3-3-3-3 ability rotation (tab between the 3s) - help other Spirits once yours are down. Dispel Crushing Shadow immediately.

First tank holds him facing away from the raid; melee stacks on his feet. Raid splits into 3 groups of 5 (exclude healers if possible), rotating through the soak zone every ~10s. Keep all DPS below all tanks on threat - Bewildering Strike will force a swap.

Starts once the 5th Blood Boil stack goes out - spread immediately for Fel Rage. Pour heals and defensive cooldowns into the Fel Rage target (paladins can run a BoP rotation on them). Not a threat wipe - with ~5s left, get back to your Phase 1 spot, since he returns to whoever tanked him at the end of P1.

Essence of Suffering - no threat table, she attacks whoever's closest, so run a tank rotation (rogues can evasion-tank, warriors can shield up) with a BoP rotation to survive. No healing works this phase - healers DPS instead, priests keep shields on whoever's tanking. Dispel the drain immediately.

Essence of Desire - your own damage gets reflected back, don't overnuke yourself. Mages spellsteal Rune Shield on sight. Run an interrupt rotation on Spirit Shock (it cannot land) and have the warrior tank Spell Reflect Deaden. Play it slow and clean.

Essence of Anger - OT initiates and taunts immediately once MT has aggro (using the 200% threat buff) before DPS pile on. Healers focus whoever's hit by Spite. Warrior MT should stance-dance right before Soul Scream to dump rage and reduce the damage taken.

Shadow resistance matters a lot (~174+ unbuffed recommended for most of the raid) - tanks don't need it, gear them for HP/mitigation instead, and stack all 3 in front of her. The instant Fatal Attraction teleports you, run away from the other linked players immediately. Stack tight through the beam phases and heal through it.

Four casters, each needs a plan: Gathios (DPS focus - dispel his stun fast, move out of Consecration), Zerevor (mage-tank only - spellsteal Dampen Magic, interrupt Arcane Bolt), Malande (needs a melee+ranged interrupt rotation on Circle of Healing), Veras (vanishes/reappears - OT re-picks him up fast, then bring him to Gathios to get cleaved). Keep Curse of Tongues up throughout.

Ranged/healers stack; the Parasitic Shadowfiend target runs away from the raid, and the adds get focused down fast once they spawn (slow traps help). MT saves Shield Block/Holy Shield for Shear and repositions Illidan after every Flame Crash.

Flames of Azzinoth - two fire-resist tanks kite the Flame adds along a set path so their breath never crosses the raid; melee focus one Flame down before swapping to the other. Ranged/healers split into 3 groups to spread Fireball damage and dodge the Eye Blast trail as it lands.
Repeats Phase 1's mechanics, but everyone now spreads 5 yards for Agonizing Flames. Designate a spot to drop/slow/kill Parasitic Shadowfiends.

Demon Phase - a warlock in shadow resistance gear solo-tanks Illidan, 20 yards from everyone else. Raid spreads for Flame Burst/Shadow Demons and kills the demons the instant they spawn. Most guilds push hard here (lust included) since he drops to Phase 5 at 30%.

Repeats Phase 3, but watch his enrage timer (+30% attack speed/+50% damage after 40s) - save cooldowns for it. Maiev drops traps around the platform; kite Illidan into one to strip the enrage and boost his damage taken. If you reach this phase, you can finish the kill.

Stack in a circle around him. Use stun-breaks (or PvP trinkets) to get out of Icebolt fast, with healers focused on whoever gets stunned. Move out of Death and Decay - a big red circle that can be easy to miss, so watch your feet.

Spread in a circle, keeping healers apart so Carrion Swarm doesn't hit more than one at a time. The Infernal target moves away from the raid before it lands, then MDs it to the OT - most groups burn the Infernal down fast rather than leave it up.

Spread out - mana users watch their mana and move away from others as it drops, since hitting 0 mana causes an AoE explosion. Ret/Prot Paladins are most at risk (low mana pools); Warlocks can stack freely since Mana Tap keeps them safe. MT faces him away from melee; OTs can help soak Cleave.

Spread out. Whoever gets the Doom debuff runs to the designated NPC group (Tauren/Thrall) so they help kill the Doomguard that spawns on death - OT picks it up and holds it, DPS ignores it and stays on the boss. Move out of fire.

One tank only (can't be crushed - Druid works well). Every group needs a shaman in Tremor Totem range for the fear. Avoid the moving fire patches (fear can push you into one), decurse Grip of the Legion immediately, and keep everyone alive - a death triggers a nasty Soul Charge effect. He has less HP than Gruul; this fight is about clean positioning, not a DPS race.
